# Underwriting Memo

**Risk summary**

Marquette Shores Hospitality operates five beachfront select-service hotels on Florida's Gulf coast with total TIV of $52.5M. The governing class is HOTL (Hotel/motel). The broker is Corvessa Insurance Brokers (Top tier). All five locations are coastal properties ranging from 1 to 22.2 km from the coast.

**Appetite and referral**

This submission requires referral per **AG-013** and **AG-007**. Four locations sit within 16 km of the coast, triggering mandatory coastal referral under **AG-013**. The HOTL class requires senior underwriter review per **AG-007**. Total TIV of $52.5M exceeds the $30M class maximum under **AG-007**. Additionally, all four coastal locations contribute to high portfolio accumulation, with existing TIV within 25 km ranging from $200M to $364M, exceeding the $25M accumulation threshold in **AG-013**. Individual location TIVs ($8.6M–$12.2M) remain below the $15M single-location cap.

**Loss history**

Five-year loss history shows four claims totaling $146.7K incurred. Losses include customer injury (2022), wind damage (2023), and slip-and-fall (2025). All claims are closed with modest severity.

**Exposure and concentration**

Significant coastal concentration risk with four Gulf-exposed properties. Portfolio accumulation is elevated across all coastal locations.

**Recommendation**

Suggest referral to senior underwriter and catastrophe modeling team for accumulation analysis before proceeding.
